purpose: Candidate controlled-English terminology contract plus immutable-native-name mapping rules for the OffMenu corpus language/terminology work. This is a readiness contract and seed, not a frozen glossary and not a completed translation.

conceptIdSpace.rule: Use stable concept/entity IDs. A single shared word may have different senses; synonyms may be different words; regional semantics must be preserved.
conceptIdSpace.idScheme: lane-local prefixed ids for seeds (langterm:<domain>:<stablelocal>) until coordinator-issued global concept IDs exist
conceptIdSpace.idStabilityNote: IDs are stable even if preferred labels/aliases change; labels/aliases/definitions/relations are versioned separately.
conceptIdSpace.identityInferenceRule: Do not merge concepts on name similarity alone; merge only evidence-backed identity with provenance.

domains.notes: distinguish food identity, cultivar, cut, preservation, cooked/raw/prepared state, edible fraction; generic flour is not automatically wheat flour
food identity vs ingredient composition; product identity is not ingredient origin
preserve ordering, safety-relevant temperature/time, quantities, yield, equipment references
preserve prepared/raw/cooked/preserved state and edible fraction context
preserve units, dimensions, basis/denominator; never invent conversions without cited method
preserve verified/conflict/unknown; similar names or translated labels do not certify allergy/halal/kosher/therapeutic suitability
merge only evidence-backed entity identity; preserve corporate registration, dates, brands, facilities, markets, relationships; GTIN prefix is not origin/ownership
preserve authoritative dated notices, source-native notice IDs, jurisdiction/markets, product/brand, affected batch/lot/GTIN, reason/status/period; translation is not proof a recall applies worldwide
preserve currency, geography/retailer, timestamp, package size, unit basis, observed vs converted; FX is dated evidence and conversion separate
entity identity, role types, relationships, facilities, markets; no origin inference from barcode prefix alone

nativeNameCategories.rule: When a native term is in one of these categories, preserve the native form as an immutable alias/note and keep any English gloss separate and labeled as interpretation.

categories.note: brand names are identity, not translatable generic terms
scientific names are identifiers, not localizable labels
native dish names may be the culturally meaningful term; English gloss is separate
some native terms need a gloss but must remain native as primary identity
legal/authority names and official notice titles are identity/citation, not localizable semantics
original ingredient wording can be evidence; preserve it
where script is identity-relevant, preserve script form

proposalGovernance.rule: Every proposal must carry native text, native language/script/locale, nativeCategory, nativeIsImmutableCategory, englishGloss, englishGlossStatus, aliasKind, regionContext, rationale, citations, confidence, reviewOutcome and a sourceEvidencePointer.
proposalGovernance.evidenceRule: Proposals never overwrite native text; they are interpretations with review status.
proposalGovernance.quarantineRule: Unsupported or ambiguous corrections remain unknown/quarantined; ambiguity never authorizes invented values.
proposalGovernance.reviewRule: Independent review is required for difficult/sensitive terms; model self-confidence and two models agreeing are not sufficient for sensitive facts.
proposalGovernance.citationRule: Every proposal cites source pointers with archive hash/version/date where applicable.

qaChecksThisContractEnables.identityPreservation: fixed identifiers and native immutable terms must not change between proposal versions
qaChecksThisContractEnables.unitAndDimensionPreservation: quantity unitId/dimension must remain preserved; no silent unit reinterpretation
qaChecksThisContractEnables.negationQualifierPreservation: negation and qualifiers in localizable text must not be dropped/flipped in glosses
qaChecksThisContractEnables.allergenDietaryClaimBoundary: dietary/allergen claims must remain evidence-backed; glosses cannot invent them
qaChecksThisContractEnables.nativeAliasPreservation: native terms in immutable categories must survive as aliases/notes alongside glosses
qaChecksThisContractEnables.proposalIntegrity: every proposal must have complete required fields and a non-empty sourceEvidencePointer for evidence-backed proposals
qaChecksThisContractEnables.translationBoundaryConformance: no doNotTranslate field may appear in a localizable translation payload

uncertainties: This contract is a lane seed; global concept IDs and final glossary version must be issued/frozen by coordinator integration.
These fixtures are representative, not exhaustive; full corpus terminology coverage is a later stage.
Some citation pointers reference semantic lane artifacts read-only; this lane does not republish or modify those artifacts.
